# semaphore_ex_ldap_group_preview (Ephemeral Resource)

Records a fresh identity-mapping preview. It does not apply assignments. Use the matching ephemeral resource to consume the structured result and token without persistent state. Opening this ephemeral resource evaluates the preview; results are not persisted in Terraform state. LDAP/OIDC previews record server-side reconciliation history. No automatic apply, renewal or deletion of audit history is performed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
ephemeral "semaphore_ex_ldap_group_preview" "example" {
  provider_id = "directory"
}

# Reference ephemeral.semaphore_ex_ldap_group_preview.example.result in an ephemeral context.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `provider_id` (String) Configured identity provider ID.

### Read-Only

- `preview_token` (String, Sensitive) Ephemeral preview token. LDAP apply accepts it for the same provider after rechecking freshness. OIDC has no public apply operation.
- `result` (Dynamic, Sensitive) Complete native result, excluding any preview token. It is ephemeral and never stored in Terraform state. Sensitive because results may describe identity or execution metadata.
